attempts.summary: Configured node1 (10.100.197.10) as the cluster's internal chrony time source (removed public pool.ntp.org servers, enabled `local stratum 10` fallback, added `allow 10.100.197.0/24`, opened firewalld `ntp` service) and configured node2 to use node1 exclusively (`server 10.100.197.10 iburst`, public pool servers removed). Verified bidirectional sync (node2 shows `^*` synced to node1; node1's `chronyc clients` lists node2 as an NTP client). Then performed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol on both nodes, confirming changed boot IDs and post-restart recovery of chronyd and the sync relationship.
